scenes.description: Opening shot of a straight paved road leading toward majestic snow-capped mountains under a bright blue sky with white clouds. A pair of hands appears at the bottom of the frame, suggesting a romantic/travel companion theme.

A couple dressed in traditional Tibetan/ethnic minority clothing stands with their backs to the camera, gazing at the snow mountain and grassland. The man wears a white inner garment with a turquoise outer robe and fur trim; the woman wears an intricately patterned traditional vest over a dress, with elaborately braided hair adorned with accessories.

Another couple (or the same couple in different outfits) stands before a mountain lake. The man wears a yellow bucket hat, green and white striped T-shirt, and beige pants; the woman wears a green short-sleeve top and denim skirt. They hold hands while looking at the scenery.
